items.exampleEn: My cousin is a teen who loves video games.
items.exampleZh: 我表弟是個熱愛電玩的青少年。

items.exampleEn: This is a quiet residential area with no shops.
items.exampleZh: 這是一個沒有商店的安靜住宅區。

items.exampleEn: Our landlord lives on the top floor.
Don't believe the gossip about our new boss.
items.exampleZh: 別相信關於新老闆的八卦。

items.exampleEn: We had a farewell dinner for our friend before she moved to Canada.
items.exampleZh: 朋友搬去加拿大前，我們為她辦了一場送別晚餐。

items.exampleEn: Let me be the first to congratulate you!
The relationship between the two companies is getting better.
items.exampleZh: 兩家公司之間的關係越來越好。

items.exampleEn: Please write your name, age, and sex on the form.
items.exampleZh: 請在表格上填寫姓名、年齡和性別。

items.exampleEn: Their marriage has lasted fifty years.
items.exampleZh: 他們的婚姻已經維持了五十年。

items.sentenceEn: In this job, your sex does not matter; only your skills do.
items.sentenceZh: 這份工作不看性別，只看能力。

items.audioEn: The landlord said we can keep a cat if we clean the apartment every week.
items.audioZh: 房東說，只要我們每週打掃公寓，就可以養貓。
items.questionZh: 房東說在什麼條件下可以養貓？

items.sentenceEn: Everyone at the office came to congratulate Tom on his promotion.
items.sentenceZh: 辦公室裡每個人都來恭喜 Tom 升職。

items.sentenceEn: Good communication is the key to a happy marriage.
items.sentenceZh: 良好的溝通是幸福婚姻的關鍵。

items.stemEn: Before leaving the company, she gave a short ____ speech to her team.
items.stemZh: 離開公司前，她向團隊做了簡短的告別致詞。

items.stemEn: People in this office love ____, so be careful what you say.
items.stemZh: 這間辦公室的人很愛八卦，所以說話要小心。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, the families on our residential street had a party for Mr. and Mrs. Chang, our landlord and his wife. After forty years of marriage, they are moving to the countryside to live near their son. It was a farewell party, but nobody was sad. Teens from the street played music, and neighbors shared old stories and a little gossip. Many people stood up to congratulate the couple. Everyone agreed that the Chang family had built a warm relationship with every family on the street.
items.passageZh: 上星期六，我們這條住宅街上的家庭為房東張先生和張太太辦了一場派對。結婚四十年後，他們要搬到鄉下，住在兒子附近。雖然是歡送派對，但沒有人難過。街上的青少年負責演奏音樂，鄰居們分享往事，也聊了一點八卦。很多人起身恭喜這對夫妻。大家都同意，張家和街上每個家庭都建立了溫暖的關係。

questions.questionZh: 張先生夫婦為什麼要搬家？

referenceEn: We want to congratulate you on your marriage.
We would like to congratulate you on getting married.
rubricZh: congratulate＋人＋on＋名詞或動名詞，on 不可少（例如 congratulate you on your marriage）
「想」可寫 want to、would like to 等
「結婚」可寫 your marriage、getting married 等

items.instructionZh: 用 relationship 造一個句子，說說你和某位家人或朋友的關係。
referenceEn: I have a good relationship with my sister.
My relationship with my father is very close.
rubricZh: relationship 表示「關係」，例如 relationship with＋人、A and B have a … relationship 等說法
